description: Official Anthropic Claude skills and capabilities

skills.name: Word Document Operations

skills.example: Generate business proposal with branded formatting

skills.name: PowerPoint Operations
skills.description: Create, edit, and analyze PowerPoint presentations
skills.example: Create investor pitch deck with charts

skills.name: Excel Spreadsheet Operations
skills.description: Create, edit, and analyze Excel spreadsheets with formulas

skills.name: PDF Operations
skills.description: Extract text from PDFs, create PDFs, handle forms
skills.input: PDF file or content to convert
skills.example: Extract data from invoice PDFs for analysis

skills.name: Algorithmic Art Generation
skills.description: Create generative art using p5.js and Processing
skills.output: Interactive p5.js sketch or static image

skills.name: Canvas Visual Design
skills.description: Create visual art in PNG or PDF formats

skills.name: Frontend Design Tools

skills.name: Slack GIF Creator

skills.name: Theme Factory

skills.example: Apply dark theme to component library

skills.name: Web Artifacts Builder
skills.description: Create complex HTML artifacts with React components

skills.name: MCP Server Builder
skills.example: Build MCP server for custom database access

skills.name: Web App Testing with Playwright
skills.description: Test local web applications using Playwright
skills.example: E2E test checkout flow on localhost:3000

skills.name: Brand Guidelines Application
skills.description: Apply brand colors, typography, and style consistently

skills.name: Document Co-authoring
